datasets.details: This is a preliminary assessment and has not yet been validated in the field. It is important to consider the characteristics and the limitations of the sources used to implement those results.

lineage.description: UNOSAT derived wind speed exposure zones from Hurricane Matthew satellite observations and classified them into three threshold categories (60, 90, 120 km/h). Population counts from census data were spatially intersected with these wind speed zones at the administrative level to quantify population exposure by wind intensity.
